author: /root/construct_integer_witnesses
claim: Actual positive real embedding of the radical tower, exact two-embedding compatibility and integer independence of the specified actual real elliptic points.

obligations.name: Actual predecessor identity
obligations.required_input: The real points must come from the literal normalized source generators.
obligations.constructed_input: Four byte-identical producer sources and realPoint applied to their firstGenerator/secondGenerator.
obligations.justification: No source P, conjugation, radical or additive normalization is reselected.

obligations.name: Quadratic extension map
obligations.required_input: The target map must preserve addition and multiplication on the entire quadratic algebra.
obligations.constructed_input: extendRoot is QuadraticAlgebra.lift with the exact base homomorphism algebra structure.
obligations.justification: The square equation supplies the lift hypothesis and extendRoot_apply proves the coordinate formula.

obligations.name: Positive radicands and roots
obligations.required_input: Both root choices must exist with specified positive signs.
obligations.constructed_input: positive_delta and positive_deltaBar; alpha,beta as Real.sqrt, with strict positivity and exact squares.
obligations.justification: The original positive embedding evaluates the radicands as3-minus-sqrt2 and3-plus-sqrt2; sqrt2<2.
obligations.source_references: positive_delta; positive_deltaBar; alpha_pos; beta_pos; alpha_square; beta_square

obligations.name: Nested scalar compatibility
obligations.required_input: The second extension must use the image of its literal First-valued radicand.
obligations.constructed_input: firstEmbedding_base identifies that image with positiveEmbedding(deltaBar).
obligations.justification: beta_square is composed with this exact identity before defining realEmbedding.

obligations.name: Two original embeddings
obligations.required_input: The maps of K must agree with the actual original positive and negative embeddings.
obligations.constructed_input: realEmbedding_base and realEmbedding_conjugateBase hold for every x:K.
obligations.justification: The first follows both algebraMap compatibilities; the second is checked on arbitrary quadratic coordinates and the exact source conjugation.

obligations.name: Actual group base change
obligations.required_input: The real map must preserve addition and be injective on the actual E_1 group.
obligations.constructed_input: realPoint composes pointMap with coefficient transport along map_one; realPoint_injective is proved.
obligations.justification: The source is the constructed field Both, so pointMap_injective applies; transport is an additive equivalence.

obligations.name: Result and coordinate identity
obligations.required_input: The real independence theorem and explicit coordinates must concern the same two points.
obligations.constructed_input: real_integer_relation transfers the exact predecessor relation; both coordinate lemmas identify these same realPoint images.
obligations.justification: map_zsmul and injectivity prove the relation result; normalize_some and realPoint_some retain all coordinate factors.

obligations.name: Topological consumer boundary
obligations.required_input: Real algebraic points alone cannot supply the closed-oval component and good-region result.
obligations.constructed_input: The actual oval map, finite-kernel/endpoint comparison, and circle/character argument remain explicit open joins.
obligations.justification: No component bound or full-product density is stated or assumed.

obligations.name: History and validation scope
obligations.required_input: Formal source progress must not be reported as full proof or new historical gap.
obligations.constructed_input: Prior compact-Lie justification retained; source-policy passes; hosted Lean and distinct review pending.
obligations.justification: No accepted manuscript or baseline is changed.
